snippet.title: Desktop Explorer - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527160/Desktop_Explorer/

Play the Demo: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2533590/Desktop_Explorer_Demo/

Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them?

For more info: https://recurringdream.studio/
